>Friendly

investment_focus.industries: We invest in founders over markets, so we're mostly sector-agnostic. Investors like to fantasize about the future, but founders forge it. That’s why we’ve followed some of Europe’s boldest entrepreneurs to every frontier from Cellular Agriculture to next-gen Popular Entertainment. We also believe you are your company’s most important asset. This is especially true at Seed. Even at the edges of DeepTech, the people you hire and the culture you foster will disproportionately define your future success. That’s why we focus on helping our founders scale as leaders.
